docstring: blind_kit_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08; why: team/RESEARCH/plans/PLAN_PROCESS_QUALITY_SYSTEM_20261108.md, fairness rules:
blind scorers, gold items, two scorers, scorer never the author). Builds a blind scoring kit for one judged drill:
make:  copies the outputs to score and the gold items into <kit>/items/ under random names (I01, I02, ...), writes
<kit>/SCORER_TASK.md (key + rubric + items, one TSV out per scorer) and a PRIVATE map <kit>/../<kit name>_MAP.tsv
(outside the kit folder: scorers never read it). Order is shuffled with a seed from the kit name (sorted, stable).
C223: refuses with REFUSED NO_GOLD (no --gold) or REFUSED BAD_GOLD (a --gold without =<known total>), exit 2.
score: after the scorers ran: agreement (build/agreement_v1.py) + gold check (each scorer within --gold-tol of each gold's
known total) + de-blinded totals per original output (mean of scorers, adjudication list). C223: a map with no gold row
prints GOLD NONE and GOLD_CHECK FAIL, exit 3.
python3 -B blind_kit_v1.py make --kit <dir> --key <KEY.md> [--rubric <file>] --item <path> ... --gold <path>=<known total> ...
python3 -B blind_kit_v1.py score --kit <dir> --scorers <A.tsv> <B.tsv> [--gold-tol 1]
tools.argparse_help:
usage: blind_kit_v1.py [-h] {make,score} ...

positional arguments:
  {make,score}

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
tools.exit_and_output: make writes the kit and SCORER_TASK.md, exit 0; REFUSED NO_GOLD (no --gold) or REFUSED BAD_GOLD (a --gold without =<known total>), exit 2, nothing written (C223); score: GOLD_CHECK PASS exit 0, GOLD_CHECK FAIL exit 3 (GOLD NONE, NO_SCORES, SCORER_OFF)

docstring: agreement_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08; why: team/RESEARCH/plans/PLAN_PROCESS_QUALITY_SYSTEM_20261108.md, fairness rule
"agreement is measured and must reach 0.80"). Agreement of 2 or more scorers on the same items.
Input: scorer TSVs with columns <unit cols...> and a points column (default: run, item, points). Rows whose item is TOTAL or
MESSY, or whose points are not numbers, are skipped. Units = the join of the unit columns.
Prints per scorer pair and overall: units, exact agreement, within-1 agreement, Krippendorff alpha (ordinal and interval),
and the units where scorers differ by more than --adjudicate points (they go to a third scorer).
Reading (content-analysis convention): alpha >= 0.80 reliable; 0.667-0.80 tentative; below 0.667 fix the scale first.
python3 -B agreement_v1.py A.tsv B.tsv [--units run,item] [--points points] [--adjudicate 1] [--self-test]
tools.argparse_help:
usage: agreement_v1.py [-h] [--units UNITS] [--points POINTS]
                       [--adjudicate ADJUDICATE] [--self-test]
                       [files ...]

positional arguments:
  files

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --units UNITS
  --points POINTS
  --adjudicate ADJUDICATE
  --self-test
tools.exit_and_output: 0 done; 2 NO COMMON UNITS; exit with a message when fewer than 2 files

docstring: leak_scan_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08, drill LEAK_SCAN, part P33; C104). Is any held-out (Feb-Mar 2026) marker or number in a file that a
hunter, assessor or curator reads? Orchestrator only: it reads the held-out results itself and never prints them.
python3 -B leak_scan_v1.py --pattern-file <the pack's held-out pattern file> --secrets <orchestrator-only files ...> --targets <files or dirs ...> [--out report.tsv]
- secrets: every signed number with 2 decimals (e.g. +1.84, -0.52) and every 'n waves' in the given held-out files (T8_RESULT.md,
HELDOUT_YARDSTICK_FEBMAR_V1.json ...). Unsigned JSON values are read from keys lead15 / lead1h / waves.
- allow: files of design-month numbers (knowledge_v1/EVIDENCE.tsv, SERIES_V2.tsv, SERIES_V2_CONFIG.json): a secret that also appears
there is a Sep-Jan number quoted beside the held-out one (the T8 page repeats them), not a held-out number, and is dropped.
- targets: files, or folders scanned for .md .tsv .json .txt (no other files; folders named jobs, pipe*, split*, library, root, prep,
setup are skipped: they are tool output, not reading material).
- a hit = the pack's held-out marker regex (--pattern-file; alarm pack HELDOUT_PATTERN.txt = build_run_v2 HELDOUT_RX: lead_2602, yardstick_heldout_febmar, 'Feb-Mar ... +n.nn' ...) or a secret number
with its sign at a word boundary. The report gives file, line number and the KIND of hit only (MARKER or NUMBER), never the number.
Exit 0 = no hit, 3 = hits, 2 = refused (no pattern file and no build_run_v2.py beside the tool) (each to be opened by hand: a number can match by chance).
tools.argparse_help:
usage: leak_scan_v1.py [-h] --secrets SECRETS [SECRETS ...]
                       --targets TARGETS [TARGETS ...] [--allow [ALLOW ...]]
                       [--out OUT] [--pattern-file PATTERN_FILE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --secrets SECRETS [SECRETS ...]
  --targets TARGETS [TARGETS ...]
  --allow [ALLOW ...]
  --out OUT
  --pattern-file PATTERN_FILE
tools.exit_and_output: 0 no hit; 3 hits (file, line, kind only, never the number); 2 REFUSED NO_PATTERN
